protocol: Identical corrected keeper anchors for all compared engines; 120 Hz updates, 20 Hz passive geometry; no interventions after setup except declared initial kick. Initial reserve and new confirmation use distinct seeds, nearby block, altered defender capabilities/momentum and 12 s possessions. Observer information never enters engine decisions. Cached historical results require identical engine/simulation hashes and exact configuration; current candidate always runs afresh.
limitations: Synthetic, no real-match validation or xG
Potential windows are geometric opportunities, not predicted goals
Geometric rays omit height and body parts; access uses existing approximate arrivalTime to radius 1.65
Shared seed does not imply shared draws after decisions diverge
Pressure means tackle range and cooldown, not a guaranteed recovery
Intent changes include target movement, not necessarily tactical oscillation
